title: Define content systems of record and storage requirements
goal: For each kind of content, one place is named as the one that counts, who may read and change it is written, and how long it is kept and when it is audited is written with the obligation behind it.

steps.do: For each kind of content, write who may read it, who may change it and who may publish it, by role, and name any kind that is private or carries someone else's personal information so it is never handed to a model or a public page.

Write how long each kind is kept and when it is checked, taking any period a contract or a regulation fixes from the obligations record and citing it, and leave every shortening of a period to the founder and counsel.
Raise to the founder each kind of content whose one true place is still ambiguous, and record the storage and retention rules as evidence on the handoff.

done_criteria.check: Does every retention period that a contract or regulation fixes cite the obligation it comes from, and does every kind of content name one place that counts?
